resources.string: Quote tests run to the end of the quotation.
Capital letters, commas and full stops in the test text
The keyboard mixes numbers into the test words
Swipe words during a test, to see how much faster gestures make you
Show the suggestion strip during a test, in its usual row above the keys. Tapping a word finishes it

The test runs in whichever language the keyboard is in. Switch languages from the panel or the spacebar. English and Bangla have their own word lists; any other language uses its downloaded or imported dictionary.
Deletes every best score, the run history and the badges
Finish a run at 100 words per minute or faster
No wrong, extra or missed characters in a full run
Finish a quote that uses every letter of the alphabet

The test runs on the keyboard. It measures the layout, the key sizes and the gestures that you type with. The text that you type during a test does not go to the text field. The scores stay on your device.

The services and models the AI tools, AI reply, the chat and the settings assistant can use. Add a service with its key, a server you run, or a model on your device. You can add the same service more than once, for a second key or a second server. One of them answers at a time: pick it under In use, or with the model picker on the AI panel.
The provider the AI tools ask. The model picker on the AI panel changes it too
Get the key from console.anthropic.com on the API keys page
Get the key from platform.openai.com on the API keys page
Get a free key from aistudio.google.com
Get the key from console.x.ai on the API keys page
Get the key from platform.deepseek.com on the API keys page
Get the key from api-dashboard.search.brave.com. The key needs the Answers plan
Leave this blank to use the key of the web search tool
Leave this blank if the service does not need a key
For example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. The app adds /chat/completions to the end.
Give the model name that the service uses

Brave searches the web before it writes each answer, so it is good for questions about facts and recent events. Your key needs the Answers plan. A key with only the Search plan does not work. Brave accepts one message only, so the app sends the instructions and the earlier chat together with your text.

Use this for a service that has the same request shape as OpenAI, for example OpenRouter, Groq, Together or Mistral. A plain HTTP address stays on your network, so keep the server on a network that you trust.
Couldn\'t get the list. Check the key and the address.
Leave this blank to use the model that the server has loaded
For example http://192.168.0.10:11434. Use the network address of your computer.
For example http://192.168.0.10:1234. Turn on the local server in LM Studio.
Start Ollama with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 so your device can reach it. In LM Studio, turn on \"serve on local network\". The plain HTTP traffic stays on your network.
The limit in tokens. One token is about three quarters of a word. A reasoning model gets four times this limit, because its reasoning uses the same budget. Select the provider maximum for long text.
How much text the on-device model holds at one time, in tokens. This covers your text and the answer together. A larger size uses more memory and loads the model again.
Target language for the Translate action
The panel shows the <think> text of reasoning models instead of a progress bar
Change between the providers that you set up and the models that you download, on the keyboard
The panel gets a Changes button that marks what the model added and what it deleted
Open a result on the changes
The panel starts on the changes instead of the plain result
Suggests how to continue your text, beside the word suggestions. When you pause after a word, the app sends the last %1$s characters before the cursor to the selected provider.
Suggests how to continue your text, beside the word suggestions. When you pause after a word, the app sends only that word to the selected provider.
Suggests how to continue your text, beside the word suggestions. The on-device model makes the suggestion, so your text stays on your device.

The app never asks in a password field, in a field that turns off suggestions, or in incognito. Each pause after a word is one request, and a new key press cancels it. Tap the suggestion to insert it. Hold it to hide AI suggestions until you go to a different field.
Sends less of your text. The suggestions are less accurate.
Also asks mid-word, or while a Chinese or Japanese reading is unconverted. This sends many more requests. A model that thinks first is skipped.
Also asks when you stop after a whole word
How many characters before the cursor each request sends
The model can ask the keyboard to look something up before it answers. It only ever does so when it needs to, and you see each request in the network activity log under "AI tool use".

This provider has no built-in support for tools, so the keyboard explains them to the model in words instead. It works, but a small model often ignores them or gets the format wrong. A provider with real tool support is far more reliable.
Let the model search the web
It writes its own search and reads the results. Searches go to whichever service the search tool uses, and count against that service\'s quota.
Let the model search the web
Set up a search service first — the model has nothing to search with
Let the model read a web page
It opens one address and reads the text on it. Needs no search service.

This is the one tool that will open an address it found in your own text, so it is off until you ask for it. The page is read as plain text and cut short; no scripts run, and nothing is sent to the page.
How many times the model may look something up before it has to answer
Each round is another request to the model, carrying everything it has found so far. Higher digs deeper into a question and costs more; lower keeps one answer cheap and quick.
Let the model use the keyboard\'s own tools, such as the weather, the calculator and the translator

Run lets the model use a tool whenever it needs to. Ask shows you each request first, with what it will send, and you allow it or not. Off keeps the tool out of the model\'s reach. Each tool that is on is described to the model in every request, which costs a little each time, and a small model on your device copes best with only a few.
These read the outside world, the way the tools on the toolbar do, through the same services and settings.
These read what is on your phone: your calendar, your notes, where you are. They ask first until you say otherwise, so text the model read on a web page cannot reach them without you seeing it.
These work on a picture you attached in the chat.
These change something on your phone. None of them can delete anything. They ask first until you say otherwise.
Finds pictures through the search tool\'s service
Today\'s and tomorrow\'s weather for any place, or for the place saved in the weather tool
Searches this keyboard\'s documentation to answer questions about the keyboard itself. Sends only the search words, to the docs site.
Reads the summary of an article, in the Wikipedia language that the encyclopedia tool uses
Looks a word up in the dictionary tool\'s sources
Translates with the translate tool\'s engine, on your device or online as you set it there
Converts money at live exchange rates from the currency tool\'s sources
Converts lengths, weights, temperatures and other measurements
Works sums out exactly, on your device, instead of guessing
Lists your events for the days the model asks about. Needs the calendar tool\'s access.
Searches your notes and reads the ones that match. With Search by meaning on, it also finds notes that say the same thing in other words. A locked note\'s text stays hidden.
Searches your snippets and reads the ones that match: their name, trigger and text, as written. With Search by meaning on, it also finds snippets that say the same thing in other words.
Finds the clips in your clipboard history that mean what the model asks about. Passwords and codes stay out. Needs Search by meaning.
Reads where your phone is, at the precision the location tool shares, with the address if you have that on
Adds an event. It can\'t change or delete one.
Adds a new note to your notes. It can\'t change or delete one.
Sets an alarm in the clock tool, once or on repeat days
Starts a countdown in the clock tool
Opens an app you have installed, by its name
Plays, pauses or skips what is playing, or says what it is. Needs the media tool\'s notification access.
Sends text or a link to a computer paired through KDE Connect
Open the calendar app with the event filled in, for you to save. Or add it directly, which needs calendar access.
No calendar on this phone can take new events.
For a model that can\'t see pictures: reads the text in one you sent, on your device, or with the scan text tool\'s online engine if you picked that
Uploads a picture you sent to the camera tool\'s search site and gives you the link to the results
Let the model use tools from servers that you add

An MCP server gives the model more tools, for example to read your notes or to add an event to a calendar. The tools run on the server that you add, not on your device. When the model uses a tool, the keyboard sends the input that the model wrote to that server. Only servers with an http or https address work. A server that starts as a program on a computer does not work on a phone. Sign-in with OAuth is not available yet. If the server gives you a token, add it as a header.
No servers yet. Press Add to add a server, or paste a JSON config from another app.

plurals.name: toolai_ai_mcp_many_tools_body
plurals.item: %1$d tool is on. The keyboard sends the description of each tool with every request, so each request gets longer and costs more. Set the tools that you do not need to Off.
%1$d tools are on. The keyboard sends the description of each tool with every request, so each request gets longer and costs more. Set the tools that you do not need to Off.

resources.string: Add servers from the MCP settings of another app, for example Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code
Paste the whole text, with the "mcpServers" or "servers" part
This is not a JSON config. Copy all of the text, from the first brace to the last.
it starts a program on a computer, which a phone cannot run
its address does not start with http or https
Leave this blank to use the name of the host
Use an address that starts with https:// or http://
Plain http sends your token and the input of the model without encryption. Use https for a server outside your network.
Auto works for almost every server. It tries Streamable HTTP first, then the older SSE type. Select SSE for an old server if Auto does not connect. Its address often ends in /sse.

The keyboard sends these headers with every request to this server. Use them for a token or an API key. For example, the name is Authorization and the value is Bearer, a space and your token. A backup without secrets does not include the headers.

The keyboard sends these headers with every request to this provider, after its own, so a header here replaces one of the same name. Some services need them, for example a session header and a User-Agent. Type {session} in a value to send an id that stays the same for one action or one chat. A backup without secrets does not include the headers.
The address changed. Connect again to get the tools at the new address.

Run: the tool runs and the keyboard does not ask you. Ask: the model waits until you allow the call. Off: the model does not see the tool. At the start, a tool that the server marks as read only runs, and all other tools ask.
Have a conversation with a model that you downloaded or set up
This deletes "%1$s". You cannot undo this.
The chats you picked are deleted for good. You cannot undo this.
Keep a history of the results
The keyboard keeps what you send and what the model answers. The records stay on your device. Nothing is kept from a password field or in incognito.
Read, copy and delete what the AI tool did
The oldest record goes when the history is full
The history is empty. Run an AI action and it appears here.
The history is off. Turn it on to keep a record of what you send to the AI tool and what it answers. The records stay on your device, and you can delete them at any time.

plurals.name: toolai_ai_history_clear_body
plurals.item: This deletes %1$d record. You cannot undo this.
This deletes %1$d records. You cannot undo this.

resources.string: Add your own actions, change the prompts, and turn off the ones that you do not use

These are the buttons on the AI panel. You can rename an action that comes with the keyboard, change its prompt, or turn it off. Turning an action off keeps it here, so you can turn it on again. Press Reset in an action to bring back the one that comes with the keyboard.
You type the prompt at every run
This action comes with the keyboard. Your changes are kept separately, so Reset brings back %1$s.
Give the model the task only. The app adds the safety text and the output rules. Write %1$s where you want the target language.
The app sends this text as it is. You write the safety text yourself.
Type the prompt at every run
The keyboard asks you for the prompt instead of using a saved one
The box opens with the prompt below already in it, so you change it instead of typing it again
The instruction box opens with this text. You can change it before each run. Write %1$s where you want the target language.
With no text in the field, the action writes new text instead of changing text
Read the text before the cursor
The action reads only the text in front of the cursor, not the whole field. Selected text always wins.
Add the result to the end
Replace adds the result after your text instead of in place of it
The model gives the result and nothing else. Turn this off for an action that explains something.
The app sends your text as it is. The safety text stops the model from reading the text of the field as commands, so turn this on only if you write that part yourself.
The prompt that the app sends
On-device models run on your device. The text that you run an action on stays on your device. The context window of the model limits the response length.
The app sends the text that you run an action on to the selected provider. This happens only when you press the action. The app keeps your keys on your device.
This tool has no trigger words. It never offers itself.
Type one of these words alone. The suggestion strip then offers to open %1$s and deletes the word. Use commas to separate more than one word.
The tool keywords are off. To turn them on, go to Typing, then Smart chips.
The word must be typed with the same capitals

Off, a trigger word matches however you type it, so "wiki", "Wiki" and "WIKI" all offer the tool. On, only the spelling above matches. Use this for a short word that is also ordinary text, such as "AI", so the chip appears for the capitals and not for the letters inside a sentence.
This field is blank. The app uses the key that is built into the app.
The weekday initials that the month grid tints
The keyboard detects the source language. You can also change this on the panel.
A chat answer from a cloud or server model ends with up to three questions you might ask next, as chips a tap puts in the message box. On-device models are never asked.

How far a Deep research report goes. Quick plans 3 sub-questions and reads 4 pages; Standard plans 4, looks again once for what is missing, and reads 8; Deep plans 6, looks again twice, and reads 14. Deeper takes longer and sends more text to the model.
Deep research shows its sub-questions and waits for Start before it searches anything. Off, the plan is shown as it runs, and Stop ends it.
Ask AI in the selection menu
Ask AI shows in other apps\' menu for selected text. Turning the AI tool off takes it out too.

The model that answers names each chat from your first message and its reply, in your language, and can rename it later when you ask and agree. Off, a chat is named after the first line of your first message.
In the chat on the keyboard, the Enter key sends. When this is off, Enter starts a new line and the Send button sends.
Save chats on this device so you can come back to them

A chat is a back and forth, so it holds more of what you wrote than a single AI action does. Turn this off and your conversations live only until you close the app, and what is already saved is deleted. Nothing is sent anywhere either way that you did not send by chatting.
Remove every saved conversation from this device
Every saved conversation is deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
How much the AI reads back
Characters before the cursor sent by a carry-on action

Actions that carry on from what you wrote send the text before your cursor. More characters give the model more of your writing to follow, which helps in a long piece. It also costs more of your tokens and takes longer on every run. This only applies when you have not selected anything: a selection is always sent as it is.
How long a drafted reply runs
How you write, what you sound like, anything the replies should know
Sent to the AI as a picture, or read on this device first
Take the copied messages and screenshots back out once a reply is used. You can turn this off for one reply in the panel
Keep drafted replies in the AI history
Off: a record of a reply holds somebody else\'s message, not your own writing
The tones on the AI reply panel. Reorder them, turn them off, edit one, or write your own. Custom… asks for an instruction each time.
Edit, reorder or turn off the tones, or write your own
One taken while the panel is open, and the newest from the last two minutes when it opens. Needs permission to read your images
Replies use the provider, key and model set up for the AI tool
The AI writing tools screen sets the provider, the key and the model. AI reply, the chat and the settings assistant use the same ones.
Show the button that opens the AI chat on every settings screen, not only this one
Off hides it from search and the AI screens, and it sends nothing
What the AI remembers about you, kept on this phone
Chats save short facts about you, and later chats and AI actions use them

The AI saves a fact when you tell it something that will still be true later, or when you ask it to remember something. Each save shows under the answer with Undo. The facts stay on this phone. Incognito fields and private chats never read or save memory, and facts that look like passwords, codes, card numbers or keys are refused. Turning this off stops reading and saving. The saved facts stay until you delete them.
Send the saved facts with requests to the AI service in use, and let its chats save new ones
Off, only a model on this phone reads or saves memory. On, the facts picked for a request travel with it to the service you use, and that service\'s own privacy terms apply to them.
Write a fact for the AI to know
Nothing saved yet. Tell the AI something about yourself in a chat, or add a fact here.
Removes every saved fact from this phone
Delete every saved memory? This cannot be undone.
This looks like a password, code, card number or key. The AI memory does not keep those.
A memory is one short fact, at most %1$d characters.
The memory cannot be read until the phone is unlocked.
The memory is full. Delete some facts first.
